description: This file defines a static helper class for managing Azure Table Storage related to stream failure handling in an Orleans streaming application. It provides methods to get failure counts and delete all entries, utilizing Azure Data Tables SDK.

classes.name: TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: A static utility class for managing Azure Table Storage operations related to streaming failure handling, including retrieving failure counts and deleting failure data.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of delivery failure entries for a specified stream provider, initializing the table and reading all relevant entries.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all entries from the failure tracking table, after initializing the table.

methods.name: GetDataManager
methods.description: Creates and configures an AzureTableDataManager instance with the appropriate credentials based on configuration, for managing table data.
